pullback_alerts.name: Vertiv Holdings Co
pullback_alerts.thesis: Makes power and cooling infrastructure for AI datacenters — UPS systems, power distribution units, liquid cooling. AI GPU racks run at 40-100kW vs 5kW traditional; liquid cooling is mandatory at that density. Vertiv is the sole at-scale provider. Backlog +100% YoY. $1.96B FCF. Microsoft, Google, Meta cited as sole-source supplier. 36.2x forward PE, -15.8% from $379 ATH.
pullback_alerts.action: Consider deploying if thesis intact. Verify with research_ticker.py first.

pullback_alerts.name: GE Vernova Inc.
pullback_alerts.thesis: Makes HA-class gas turbines (most efficient in existence), wind, and grid equipment. Hyperscalers ordering GE turbines to build dedicated AI datacenter power plants. One of only 3 companies globally that can make utility-scale gas turbines. $9.32B FCF. Grid equipment (transformers, switchgear) sold out through 2027. 42.1x forward PE, -12.7% from $1,181 ATH.
pullback_alerts.action: Consider deploying if thesis intact. Verify with research_ticker.py first.

pullback_alerts.name: Broadcom Inc.
pullback_alerts.thesis: Second-largest AI chip company by revenue. Designs custom XPU accelerators for Google (TPU) and Meta (MTIA) — both committed to $1B+ AVGO roadmaps through 2027. VMware integration completing, op margin should expand from 45% to 55%+. Networking silicon (Tomahawk switches) is a winner-take-most market for AI cluster fabric. 29.5% revenue growth, 23x forward PE.
pullback_alerts.action: Consider deploying if thesis intact. Verify with research_ticker.py first.

upcoming_earnings.name: Micron Technology, Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Only US-based HBM3E manufacturer — every NVIDIA H100/H200/B200 GPU requires High Bandwidth Memory stacked on the die. Samsung and SK Hynix dominate HBM but Micron has a geopolitical moat as the only American supplier. 196% revenue growth YoY (coming off cyclical trough), 8.2x forward PE. DATA QUALITY WARNING: yfinance shows $864 price — verify on Fidelity before acting. Memory is cyclical; this growth rate will moderate but AI demand provides a structural floor.
